hooks.name: Agent stop gate
hooks.description: Blocks completion while any property or invariant test in the workspace is failing. On red it prints the documented Stop-hook block decision, so the agent must take another turn and fix it. Exit 0 with a block decision, not exit 2: only exit 1 or a block decision restarts a Stop turn.

action.command: cd "$KIRO_WORKSPACE_ROOT" && if pnpm test >/tmp/afterglow-stop-gate.log 2>&1; then exit 0; else r=$(tail -40 /tmp/afterglow-stop-gate.log | jq -Rs . 2>/dev/null || echo '"tests are red; see /tmp/afterglow-stop-gate.log"'); printf '{"decision":"block","reason":%s}\n' "$r"; echo 'Agent stop gate: invariant tests are RED. Fix before completing.' >&2; exit 0; fi
